# Web editor / automation workflow

Use **repo-local** **`pnpm` / `npm`** scripts-no arbitrary remote tooling.

## Recommended order after edits

1. **Format** - Prettier or Biome (project config wins).
2. **Lint** - ESLint (**`eslint --fix`**) where configured.
3. **Typecheck** - **`pnpm run typecheck`** or **`tsc --noEmit`**. Prefer **`--incremental`** + explicit **`tsBuildInfoFile`** for speed on large apps when applicable; consider a **`timeout`** (or IDE cancel) so stuck `tsc` runs cannot pile up.
4. **Optional CSS lint** - stylelint/postcss when present.
5. **Session sanity** - **`pnpm build`** (or staging build) before merge-not necessarily after every keystroke.

## Verification

Run format / lint / typecheck via **repo scripts** (`docs/project/setup.md`). This project does **not** use Cursor `hooks.json` automation - keep the agent loop lean.

## File size discipline

Prefer **focused modules**: if a UI file blows past **~800 lines**, split by feature-not a hard OS hook requirement unless you automate it.
